sources.title: imanaswer/Lunar-Lander-PPO- - GitHub
sources.snippet: The Lunar Lander environment simulates the landing of a lunar module on a lunar surface. The agent's goal is to control the lunar module's thrusters to land safely while avoiding obstacles and managing fuel consumption. This project involves training an RL agent using PPO, a state-of-the-art algorithm that balances exploration and exploitation to find optimal policies.
